paragraph: In October 2024 MESCTI's planning and statistics office [published the 10th Anuario Estatistico do Ensino Superior](<https://mescti.gov.ao/media/uploads/ANUARIO_ESTATISTICO_2023_2024_5824af246e.pdf>), covering 2023-2024. Its figures on students, graduates, staff and grants come from the higher education institutions and INAGBE. [In December 2023 the ministry published the 7th edition](<https://c2a.portais.gov.ao/uploads/Publicacao_638494608243198556_f5b5215e8a.pdf>), compiled from seven administrative primary registers. In the last twelve months, [the World Bank reported in September 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099092526002549347/pdf/P178043-e43e72a0-0ef6-4b41-b196-f41e92b8c8f9.pdf>) that INE and the Bank had agreed to cut the administrative data pilot from five ministries to three. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

The health information directorate [states it produces a health statistics yearbook every year](<https://ahofiles.afro.who.int/afahobckpcontainer/production/files/Annuaire_des_Statistiques_Sanitaires_2024_VF.pdf>). The 2024 edition was published in August 2025, and follows a 2023 edition. In the last twelve months, [the trade, transport, industry and tourism ministry published its sectoral statistical yearbook, edition 2024, in January 2026](<https://api.insbu.bi/storage/documents/01KRXTD00HD7QH9TWKPF45K76J.pdf>). [The education ministry's planning and statistics bureau published the education statistical yearbook 2024-2025, Tome 2, in December 2025](<https://mesrs.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Tome-2_Annuaire__2024_2025.pdf>). No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

INStaD [published its yearbook of civil-status statistics for 2024](<https://www.instad.bj/images/docs/insae-statistiques/Etat-civil/ANNUAIRE_DES_STAT_DE_L'ETAT_CIVIL_2024.pdf>), dated November 2025. It is compiled from the civil-registration database of ANIP and covers births, marriages and deaths for all 77 communes. INStaD states that it schedules a yearbook of civil-status statistics in its work plan every year. It says that since 2023 its data come from the ANIP database. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

The Ministry of Health [published its Annuaire statistique 2024 in April 2025](<https://www.wakatsera.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/annuaire-statistique-2024-du-ministere-burkinabe-de-la-Sante.pdf>), with figures for 2024. Its data come from the monthly activity reports of health facilities. These are entered in the Endos-BF data warehouse. The yearbook says it follows previous editions. It says the yearbook for year n-1 must be available by June of year n. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[Statistics Botswana released its Vital Statistics Report 2024 in August 2026](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/Vital%20Statistics%20Report%202024.pdf>). It is compiled from the Births and Deaths Registration System and civil registration records, and counts 49,180 births and 14,070 deaths in 2024. [Its Statistical Year Book 2020/21, dated November 2023](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/The%20Statistical%20Year%20Book%202020-21.pdf>), draws its vital statistics from the same registration department. In the last twelve months, Statistics Botswana released the August 2026 report. No other administrative source has been found published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

On 15 November 2024 ICASEES [published the statistical yearbook for pre-school, Fondamental 1 and non-formal basic education](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/publications/tableau-de-bord/donnees-sectorielles/education-nationale/annuaire-satistique-fondamental-1-alphabetisation-et-education-de-base-non-formelle-2021-2022>), covering school year 2021-2022. In the last twelve months, [a World Bank mission to ICASEES on 7 and 8 October 2026 discussed developing administrative statistics of education and higher education](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/427-icasees-la-mission-dappui-de-la-banque-mondiale-au-projet-hiswaca-sop2>). [On 18 February 2026 the HISWACA-SOP 2 project handed 300 motorcycles to school sector chiefs](<https://www.icasees.org/index.php/actualites/322-icasees-hiswaca-sop-2-ceremonie-officielle-de-remise-des-motos-aux-chefs-de-secteur-scolaire-de-leducation-nationale>) to speed the collection of school data. No second edition has been found. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[On 30 June 2025 the Ministry of the Interior and Security presented the civil status yearbook for 2024](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2635039/economie/annuaire-statistique-detat-civil-de-lannee-2024-le-taux-denregistrement-des-naissances-dans-les-delais-en-nette-regression>). It is compiled from civil registration records. In the last twelve months, [on 31 July 2026 the ministry's statistics directorate presented the yearbook for 2025](<https://www.aip.ci/cote-divoire-aip-le-taux-denregistrement-annuel-des-naissances-progresse-a-576-en-2025-contre-547-en-2022-officiel/>), with ANSTAT and UNICEF. The yearbook has appeared twice in thirteen months. No source found states that it is published every year. No source found shows three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that shows statistics from administrative records published in Cameroon. No register assessment, staff training, data-sharing agreement or pilot towards them has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no official statistics are drawn from administrative records and no work towards them is under way.

[A joint UN pilot, funded by the Joint SDG Fund, is digitalising civil registration of births, marriages and deaths in Masina commune, Kinshasa, on DHIS2](<https://drc.unfpa.org/fr/news/rdc-masina-commune-pilote-pour-la-digitalisation-des-faits-de-letat-civil>), and was under way in August 2025. UNICEF, BCNUDH, UNHCR and UNFPA run it with technical support from the national statistics institute (INS), to generate statistics for SDG monitoring. [In December 2023 the INS and UNFPA adopted a roadmap for producing vital statistics from civil registration](<https://drc.unfpa.org/fr/news/enregistrement-des-faits-d%C3%A9tat-civil-et-production-de-statistiques-vitales-unfpa-et-ses>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports statistics from administrative records published since October 2023. Establishing would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published in the past three years.

[On 10 November 2025 the Institut national de la statistique, customs, the BEAC, the national oil company, the ports and the single window agreed at a workshop to share their databases for foreign trade statistics](<https://congo-b.com/statistiques-export-lins-muscle-ses-outils/>). [They adopted a draft decree on data-transmission obligations](<https://congo-b.com/statistiques-export-lins-muscle-ses-outils/>). [A pilot collection into a data warehouse at the Institute is planned from January](<https://congo-b.com/statistiques-export-lins-muscle-ses-outils/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports statistics from administrative records published since October 2023. Establishing would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published in the past three years.

[WHO Comoros's annual report of July 2025 reports having supported the first quarterly health information bulletins](<https://afro.who.int/sites/default/files/2025-07/Rapport%20annuel%20_%20OMS%20Comores%20_%20PUBLICATION%2010%2007%202025.pdf>), the bulletins trimestriels d'information sanitaire, a quarterly series from the health information system. [A preliminary mission report posted in June 2024 lists the 2023 health statistical yearbook as still to be drafted and validated](<https://mptf.undp.org/sites/default/files/documents/2024-06/comoros_sids.pdf>). The mission also looked at improving trade statistics from information exchanged between customs services. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[On 1 October 2025 the Instituto Nacional de Estatistica released its fifth Estatisticas Vitais report, covering 2016-2023](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2025/10/01/estatisticas-vitais-de-2023-registam-queda-na-natalidade-obitos-e-casamentos/99233>). Its 2023 figures, 6,760 births, 2,925 deaths and 2,435 marriages, come from the administrative records of the Registos, Notariado e Identificacao. [On 14-16 April 2025 Cabo Verde assessed its death certification and cause-of-death notification process](<https://www.afro.who.int/countries/cabo-verde/news/cabo-verde-takes-historic-step-mortality-management-support-who-and-portuguese-cooperation>), with WHO support. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

No stage is set. Open Data Watch lists yearbook figures from ministry records, the latest for 2022. Civil registration is kept in [paper registers with decentralized civil registrars](<https://data.unicef.org/crvs/djibouti/>). No statistics from administrative records published since October 2023 have been found. No work towards them has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Establishing would need statistics derived from at least one administrative data source to have been published in the past three years.

[In July 2024 the ONS bulletin Démographie algérienne 2020 à 2023 (N°1030) reported 895,000 live births, 192,000 deaths and 278,000 marriages for 2023](<https://www.lifetable.de/File/GetDocument/data/DZA/DZA000020232023AU1.pdf>). [The ONS built the report on an exhaustive survey of the communes' civil-status services](<https://econostrum.info/algerie/demographie-natalite-esperance-de-vie/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that statistics from administrative records are published regularly. No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[The education ministry's statistical yearbook for 2024/25 reports schools, classes, pupils, exam results and teachers](<https://emis.gov.eg/statistics/books/2024-2025/main_book2024.html>). It draws on the ministry's central database. [Egypt's presentation states CAPMAS produces annual as well as monthly reports of births and deaths](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-egypt_crvs_transformation_journey.pdf>), from the central civil registration database. In the last twelve months, [Egypt's Financial Regulatory Authority and CAPMAS signed their first data-sharing protocol on 23 June 2026](<https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypts-fra-capmas-sign-first-data-sharing-pact-on-insurance-brokerage-sectors/>), under which CAPMAS receives data on insurance and securities brokerage firms. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

In December 2024 the Ministry of Education [published Eritrea: Basic Education Statistics 2023/24](<https://www.ecss-online.com/2013/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Basic-Education-Statistics-2023-24.pdf>). It is the 26th report of its Department of Research and Human Resource Development, drawn from annual school censuses. [In 2022 the Ministry of Health's HMIS unit produced an Annual Health Service Activity Report every year](<https://www.afro.who.int/sites/default/files/2023-02/WHO%20Annual%20Report%20-%202022.pdf>) from routine records reported through DHIS2. DHIS2 was functional in 44% of districts. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[In October 2023 the Ministry of Education's EMIS and ICT Executive Office released the Education Statistics Annual Abstract 2022/2023](<https://moe.gov.et/storage/Books/ESAA%202022-23%20Final.pdf>). It covers general education from records collected by EMIS. [In February 2025 the Ethiopian Statistics Service released the 2015 E.C. Statistical Abstract in print and on its website](<https://ess.gov.et/%e1%8b%93%e1%88%98%e1%89%b3%e1%8b%8a-%e1%8b%a8%e1%88%b5%e1%89%b3%e1%89%b2%e1%88%b5%e1%89%b2%e1%8a%ad%e1%88%b5-%e1%88%98%e1%8c%bd%e1%88%94%e1%89%b5-%e1%88%88%e1%89%b0%e1%8c%a0%e1%89%83%e1%88%9a/>). [Its Director General said administrative records from various institutions are one source for the figures](<https://ess.gov.et/%e1%8b%93%e1%88%98%e1%89%b3%e1%8b%8a-%e1%8b%a8%e1%88%b5%e1%89%b3%e1%89%b2%e1%88%b5%e1%89%b2%e1%8a%ad%e1%88%b5-%e1%88%98%e1%8c%bd%e1%88%94%e1%89%b5-%e1%88%88%e1%89%b0%e1%8c%a0%e1%89%83%e1%88%9a/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[On 8 July 2024 a Libreville workshop opened to evaluate the plan of an education statistical yearbook](<https://union.sonapresse.com/fr/education-vers-lelaboration-dun-annuaire-statistique>). [It followed a school data collection involving several administrations, the Direction generale de la Statistique among them](<https://union.sonapresse.com/fr/education-vers-lelaboration-dun-annuaire-statistique>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Open Data Watch's 2024 review lists a statistics office publication giving school and teacher numbers, latest data year 2021](<https://odin.opendatawatch.com/>). No source found reports statistics from administrative records published since October 2023. Establishing would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published in the past three years.

[In 2024 the Births and Deaths Registry published its 2022 Statistical Report: Death Registration](<https://bdr.gov.gh/storage/formidable/7/STATISTICAL-REPORT-ON-DEATH-REGISTRATION-2022.pdf>), its inaugural statistical report. Its [2022 Statistical Report Birth Registration](<https://bdr.gov.gh/storage/formidable/7/STATISTICAL-REPORT-ON-BIRTH-REGISTRATION-2022.pdf>) gives registered births in 2022. In the last twelve months, [the Ghana Statistical Service signed a memorandum with 25 bodies in March 2026](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/03/gss-25-mdas-sign-data-sharing-agreements/>) to share administrative data. [By October 2026 it held memoranda with 26 institutions](<https://thevaultznews.com/2026/10/23/ghana-pledges-to-link-official-statistics-with-maps/>), and [by November 2026 it had signed 33](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/business/business-news/data-forum-urges-government-to-expedite-statistics-bill-and-national-statistics-fund.html>). No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[Since 2014 the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has published education data in its Statistical Yearbook](<https://education.dhis2.org/the-gambia-launches-online-education-data-centre/>). It is compiled from questionnaires collected at schools each November and published the following May. [In June 2026 the Gambia Bureau of Statistics published its Transport Statistics 2025 Summary Report](<https://www.gbosdata.org/downloads-file/639-transport-statistics-summary-report-2025>), compiled from administrative data of the civil aviation, ports, ferry and police services. In the last twelve months, the Bureau published that report and the ministry published the 2026 yearbook edition. No source found shows statistics from health or civil registration records. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[In 2024 INE published its yearbook of vital statistics for 2018-2022](<https://www.stat-guinebissau.com/Menu_principal/IV_RGPH/rgph1/projecoes/Anuario%20Final_de_Estatisticas_Vitais.pdf>), drawn from the justice ministry's paper civil-registration records of births, marriages and deaths. [The ministry sends INE the databases each year in Excel](<https://www.stat-guinebissau.com/Menu_principal/IV_RGPH/rgph1/projecoes/Anuario%20Final_de_Estatisticas_Vitais.pdf>). [Deaths and causes also come from DHIS2, and births from the RapidPro platform](<https://www.stat-guinebissau.com/Menu_principal/IV_RGPH/rgph1/projecoes/Anuario%20Final_de_Estatisticas_Vitais.pdf>). [In August 2025 UNFPA, INE and the justice ministry trained 42 professionals in descriptive statistics](<https://guinea-bissau.unfpa.org/en/news/strengthening-guinea-bissaus-future-civil-registry-professionals-master-data-skills>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[From 16 to 18 December 2025 STATAFRIC and Statistics Sweden ran a workshop with INEGE in Malabo on migration data](<https://statafric.au.int/en/news/press-releases/2025-12-19/enhancing-migration-data-central-africa-statafric-statistics-sweden>). [It assessed the administrative sources of migration data and trained participants](<https://statafric.au.int/en/news/press-releases/2025-12-19/enhancing-migration-data-central-africa-statafric-statistics-sweden>). [It drafted terms of reference for a national migration data working group and set a roadmap](<https://statafric.au.int/en/news/press-releases/2025-12-19/enhancing-migration-data-central-africa-statafric-statistics-sweden>). The workshop took place in the last twelve months. No source found reports statistics from administrative records published since October 2023. Establishing would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published in the past three years.

[The Kenya National Bureau of Statistics published the Economic Survey 2025, with figures for 2024](<https://www.knbs.or.ke/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/2025-Economic-Survey.pdf>). Its statistics draw on administrative data collected by ministries, departments, agencies and county governments. [The Kenya Vital Statistics Report 2023 presents 2023 vital statistics extracted from the civil registration system](<https://www.knbs.or.ke/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/2023-Kenya-Vital-Statistics-Report.pdf>). [Its foreword says the 2023 edition is the eleventh in a series of annual reports produced since 2010](<https://www.knbs.or.ke/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/2023-Kenya-Vital-Statistics-Report.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[In December 2023 LISGIS published the fourth volume of its Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin, compiled mainly from administrative data of ministries, agencies and commissions](<https://lisgis.gov.lr/uploads/statisticalbulletines/socialstatisticsBulletin2023.pdf>). [It covers education, health, security, trade, transport and more, mostly for 2016-2022](<https://lisgis.gov.lr/uploads/statisticalbulletines/socialstatisticsBulletin2023.pdf>). [In 2025 the education portal presented statistics from the ministry's school and learner records for 2024-25](<https://www.emis-moe-lib.org/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that statistics from administrative records are published regularly. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that shows statistics from administrative records published in Libya. No register assessment, staff training, data-sharing agreement or pilot towards them has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says no official statistics are drawn from administrative records and no work towards them is under way.

[The Bureau of Statistics published the 2022 Vital Statistics Report (Statistical Report No. 04, 2024)](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/lesotho-2022-vital-statistics-report.pdf>), covering births, deaths, marriages and divorces registered in 2022. [Its publications page also lists vital statistics reports of births and deaths for 2020 and 2021](<https://www.bos.gov.ls/publications.htm>), without publication dates. [In July 2024 the Bureau said it had held a workshop on modernising administrative data for official statistics](<https://archive.uneca.org/archive2/eca-events/sites/default/files/resources/documents/acs/sixth-africa-gender-statistics-forum/7._nsds-ii_funding_strategy_of_lesotho.pdf>), financed by the Economic Commission for Africa. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found dates a second edition since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[In February 2024 the Ministry of Public Health published the 26th edition of its health sector statistics yearbook](<https://instat.mg/p/msanp-annuaire-des-statistiques-du-secteur-sante-de-madagascar-2023>), covering 2023. [Its data come from health facilities' monthly activity reports](<https://instat.mg/p/msanp-annuaire-des-statistiques-du-secteur-sante-de-madagascar-2023>), from community sites, basic health centres and hospitals. [The 2023 yearbook is the 26th edition since 1998](<https://instat.mg/p/msanp-annuaire-des-statistiques-du-secteur-sante-de-madagascar-2023>), the year the health information management system was set up. INSTAT posted it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows statistics from three administrative sources, each published twice since October 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[INSTAT's publications page of October 2026 lists its quarterly foreign trade bulletins](<https://www.instat-mali.org/fr/publications/statistiques-du-commerce-exterieur>) up to the first quarter of 2026, with trade yearbooks for 2017 to 2025. [INSTAT values the goods in the bulletin from customs declarations](<https://www.instat-mali.org/fr/publications/statistiques-du-commerce-exterieur>). [The health and social sector planning unit published the SNISS yearbook for 2023](<https://bibliostat.instat.ml/greenstone3/library/collection/sant/document/HASH01915e0cf9b388acc96f8e9e?ed=1>). In the last twelve months, [the World Bank reported in December 2025 that the education yearbooks for 2023/24 and 2024/25 were delayed](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121925133063670/pdf/P164032-3dbd8877-99ba-4d00-8051-52eac68d5d74.pdf>). No source found shows a second edition of health, social or education statistics since November 2023. Mature would need statistics from at least three administrative data sources, each published at least twice in the last three years.

[In August 2026 the statistics institute INE published its vital statistics report for 2024-2025](<https://dossiersefactos.com/2026/08/28/mocambique-falha-registo-de-9-em-cada-10-bebes-que-nascem/>), giving births and deaths registered in 2025, among them 38,032 deaths. It draws them from the records of the civil registration system. In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the Ministry of Justice and INE agreed to link the electronic civil registration system to INE's statistical systems](<https://aimnews.org/2026/05/18/mjcr-e-ine-ligam-sistemas-para-modernizar-estatisticas-vitais/>), to share data on births, deaths, marriages and other events. No source found states that the report is published regularly. No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[In July 2025 the health ministry held a workshop to review the data of its health information system](<https://elhadeth.mr/node/31262>). It looked at 2024 and the first half of 2025. The review prepared the national statistical yearbook for 2024 and a bulletin for the first quarter of 2025. No published edition of either is on record. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found reports statistics from administrative records published since October 2023. Establishing would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published in the past three years.

[On 28 August 2026 Statistics Mauritius published Population and Vital Statistics for January-June 2026](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/Statistics/ESI/2026/EI1949/Pop_Vital_Midyr26_280826.pdf>), drawn from the Civil Status Division's computerised system. [It reports 6,386 live births and 6,333 deaths registered in those six months](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/Statistics/ESI/2026/EI1949/Pop_Vital_Midyr26_280826.pdf>). In the last twelve months, Statistics Mauritius made that release. [In October 2023 two Statistics Finland experts reviewed the data sources used to update the Statistical Business Register](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/About_US/Annual_Report/Annual_Report_yr23-yr24_Statistics_Mauritius_031224.pdf>), under the EU-funded PAS2 project. [A study tour in Oslo on 21-24 May 2024 covered using administrative data and quality control of the business register](<https://statsmauritius.govmu.org/Documents/About_US/Annual_Report/Annual_Report_yr23-yr24_Statistics_Mauritius_031224.pdf>). No source found shows statistics from one administrative source published twice since October 2023. Operating would need statistics from at least one administrative data source, published at least twice in the last three years.

[In April 2025 the National Statistics Office, National Registration Bureau and Ministry of Health published Malawi's first vital statistics report from civil registration records](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/malawi-vital-statistics-report-2024.pdf>). [It covers births for 2015-2022 and deaths, with causes, for 2017-2022](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/malawi-vital-statistics-report-2024.pdf>). [The Minister of Homeland Security launched it on 23 April 2025, with UNDP backing](<https://www.nyasatimes.com/chingoma-unveils-groundbreaking-vital-statistics-and-verbal-autopsy-reports/>). In the last twelve months, [an IOM project began in October 2026](<https://d-portal.iatistandard.org/ctrack.html#view=act&aid=XM-DAC-47066-DA0113>) that supports the National Statistical Office on administrative data standards for migration, and runs to September 2028.
